This section presents applied machine learning systems inspired by production environments, particularly those documented in *Meituan’s Machine Learning Practice*. Projects are organized by domain and reflect real-world workflows such as feature engineering, search ranking, ad optimization, and deployment-oriented deep learning.

Each project emphasizes practical problem solving, systems thinking, and performance evaluation in context.

## Sections

End-to-end ML pipelines, problem formulation, model evaluation, and ensemble methods.

### Data Mining and User Profiling
[02-data-mining.qmd](02-data-mining.qmd)
User segmentation, POI linking, and opinion mining using structured and unstructured data.

### Search and Recommendation Systems
[03-search-and-recommendation.qmd](03-search-and-recommendation.qmd)
Learning-to-rank models, semantic query understanding, and personalized recommendation strategies.

### Computational Advertising
[04-computational-advertising.qmd](04-computational-advertising.qmd)
Bidding algorithms, targeting systems, and business-value aligned optimization in ad delivery.

### Deep Learning Applications

Applied deep learning for text, vision, and relevance modeling in large-scale service systems.
